basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a 25-year-old currently living in Brisbane, Australia. I'm a recent graduate in environmental science who loves exploring nature and learning about sustainable living. I enjoy playing video games, particularly first-person shooters like COD. My weekends are usually spent hiking or catching up on the latest TV shows. In a relationship for the past two years with my partner who is incredibly supportive of my transition journey. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during lunch breaks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in environmental science from my university studies, which has instilled in me a passion for sustainability. Recently, I've been learning more about transgender health and post-surgery care through online forums and articles, as well as personal experiences shared by others.
